defects: Typeclass hypotheses substantially weakened: gold requires ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder, OrderTopology, and DenselyOrdered on α (needed for order-completeness/IVT-style compactness arguments); produced only assumes LinearOrder, TopologicalSpace, OrderClosedTopology, which is insufficient for the theorem to hold in general (e.g. fails for α = ℚ)
Uses Icc a b instead of uIcc a b, so it does not cover the case b ≤ a that the gold statement (via uIcc) handles
